2027-08-12.meaning: Rav Kook answered: then we rebuild with baseless love. a fast day, and a day to soften.

2027-08-14.title: Parashat Vaetchanan
2027-08-14.line: comfort ye, comfort ye my people.
2027-08-14.meaning: the Shabbat of comfort after Tisha B'Av. this portion also holds the Shema and the Ten Commandments.
2027-08-14.source: Deuteronomy 3:23-7:11; line from Isaiah 40:1 (haftarah of Shabbat Nachamu)

2027-08-18.title: a day of love
2027-08-18.line: there were no happier days for Israel than the fifteenth of Av and Yom Kippur.
2027-08-18.meaning: young women went out in white to dance in the vineyards. today is a Jewish day of love.

2027-08-21.title: Parashat Eikev
2027-08-21.line: man doth not live by bread only.
2027-08-21.meaning: we need food, and we need meaning. feed both this week.

2027-08-28.title: Parashat Re'eh
2027-08-28.line: thou shalt surely open thy hand unto thy poor and needy brother.
2027-08-28.meaning: an open hand, not a closed fist. the month of Elul is almost here.

2027-09-03.title: i am my beloved's
2027-09-03.line: i am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine.
2027-09-03.meaning: the first letters spell Elul. a month of return before the new year: the shofar sounds each morning.

2027-09-04.title: Parashat Shoftim
2027-09-04.meaning: the word justice is said twice. the sages said: pursue justice by just means.

2027-09-11.title: Parashat Ki Teitzei
2027-09-11.meaning: about returning lost things: you can't pretend you didn't see. care is a responsibility.

2027-09-18.title: Parashat Ki Tavo
2027-09-18.line: thou shalt rejoice in all the good which the LORD thy God hath given unto thee.
2027-09-18.meaning: bringing the first fruits was a joy, not a tax. count your good this week.

2027-09-25.title: Parashat Nitzavim-Vayeilech
2027-09-25.meaning: the last Shabbat of the year. the word is very near you, in your mouth and heart. in many communities, Selichot prayers begin tonight.

2027-10-01.title: a sweet new year
2027-10-01.line: may you be written down for a good year.
2027-10-01.meaning: Rosh Hashanah 5788 begins tonight. dip apple in honey for a sweet year.

2027-10-02.title: remembered
2027-10-02.line: and the LORD remembered Sarah as he had said.
2027-10-02.meaning: today is the Day of Remembrance. because it's Shabbat, the shofar waits until tomorrow.

2027-10-03.title: into the sea
2027-10-03.line: thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
2027-10-03.meaning: today the shofar sounds, and many go to flowing water for tashlich, tossing crumbs to let go.

2027-10-04.title: seek while near
2027-10-04.line: seek ye the LORD while he may be found.
2027-10-04.meaning: a fast day in the Ten Days of Return. the door is open.

2027-10-09.title: Parashat Ha'azinu
2027-10-09.line: my doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew.
2027-10-09.meaning: Moses' song: teaching like gentle rain. today is Shabbat Shuva, the Shabbat of return, between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur.

2027-10-10.title: make peace first
2027-10-10.line: for wrongs between people, Yom Kippur does not atone until they make peace.
2027-10-10.meaning: before Kol Nidre tonight, the custom is to reach out and ask forgiveness.

2027-10-11.title: the fast that matters
2027-10-11.line: is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry?
2027-10-11.meaning: read on Yom Kippur morning: the real fast is kindness. may you be sealed for good.

2027-10-15.title: into the booth
2027-10-15.line: ye shall dwell in booths seven days.
2027-10-15.meaning: a week of eating, and for some sleeping, under a leafy roof. Sukkot begins tonight.

2027-10-16.title: altogether joyful
2027-10-16.line: and thou shalt be altogether joyful.
2027-10-16.meaning: Sukkot is called the season of our joy. since it's Shabbat, the lulav waits until tomorrow.

2027-10-17.title: four kinds
2027-10-17.line: the fruit of goodly trees, branches of palm trees... and willows of the brook.
2027-10-17.meaning: the midrash says the four species are four kinds of people. held together, they make a blessing.

2027-10-18.title: guests in the sukkah
2027-10-18.line: welcome the ushpizin, the honored guests.
2027-10-18.meaning: by tradition, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob and other ancestors visit the sukkah, one each night. who would you invite?

2027-10-19.title: stars through the roof
2027-10-19.line: the sukkah roof is open enough to see the stars.
2027-10-19.meaning: a home that is beautiful and fragile at once. like life.

2027-10-20.title: the shade of faith
2027-10-20.line: the sukkah is the shade of faith.
2027-10-20.meaning: sitting under a thin roof is a quiet act of trust.

2027-10-21.title: the water-drawing joy
2027-10-21.line: whoever has not seen the joy of the water-drawing has never seen joy.
2027-10-21.meaning: in Temple times, there was all-night dancing on Sukkot. joy is part of worship.

2027-10-22.title: save us, please
2027-10-22.line: save now, we beseech thee, O LORD.
2027-10-22.meaning: the great Hoshana: seven circles, willows beaten on the ground, a last plea for a good year.

2027-10-23.title: one more day
2027-10-23.line: it is hard for me to part from you; stay one more day.
2027-10-23.meaning: Rashi pictures a king asking his guests to linger. today the prayer for rain begins.

2027-10-24.title: the circle closes
2027-10-24.line: there hath not arisen a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses.
2027-10-24.meaning: we read the Torah's last words, then start again at Bereshit. and we dance with the scrolls.
2027-10-24.source: Deuteronomy 34:10 (in Israel, Simchat Torah was yesterday)

2027-10-30.title: Parashat Bereshit
2027-10-30.line: and God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good.
2027-10-30.meaning: the Torah starts again from the beginning. creation is called very good, and so is starting over.

2027-11-01.title: Cheshvan begins
2027-11-01.meaning: after a full month of festivals, ordinary days return. they're holy too.

2027-11-06.title: Parashat Noach
2027-11-06.line: Noah was in his generations a man righteous and whole-hearted; Noah walked with God.
2027-11-06.meaning: you can be good even when the world around you isn't.

2027-11-13.title: Parashat Lech Lecha
2027-11-13.line: look now toward heaven, and count the stars.
2027-11-13.meaning: God takes Abraham outside to look up. sometimes hope needs a bigger sky.

2027-11-20.title: Parashat Vayera
2027-11-20.line: is any thing too hard for the LORD?
2027-11-20.meaning: Sarah laughed at the idea of a child so late. then she named him Isaac, 'laughter.'

2027-11-27.title: Parashat Chayei Sara
2027-11-27.line: and he loved her. and Isaac was comforted for his mother.
2027-11-27.meaning: grief and love sit side by side in this verse. new love doesn't erase old love.

2027-12-01.title: Kislev begins
2027-12-01.line: Kislev is the month of Hanukkah.
2027-12-01.meaning: the nights are getting longer. the lights are coming.

2027-12-04.title: Parashat Toldot
2027-12-04.line: Isaac digged again the wells of water... in the days of Abraham his father.
2027-12-04.meaning: he reopened his father's wells and gave them the same names. honor what came before, then add your own.

2027-12-11.title: Parashat Vayetzei
2027-12-11.line: and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
2027-12-11.meaning: seven years of work felt like days. love changes how time feels.

2027-12-18.title: Parashat Vayishlach
2027-12-18.line: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name.
2027-12-18.meaning: after a long struggle, a new name. people can grow into someone new.

2027-12-24.title: the first candle
2027-12-24.line: blessed are you... who performed miracles for our ancestors in those days, at this season.
2027-12-24.meaning: Hanukkah begins tonight. it's Friday, so light the menorah first, then the Shabbat candles.

2027-12-25.title: a great miracle
2027-12-25.meaning: the four letters on a dreidel. tonight, light two candles after Shabbat ends. this Shabbat's portion is Vayeshev, Joseph's dreams.

2027-12-26.title: the helper candle
2027-12-26.line: the helper candle lights all the others.
2027-12-26.meaning: the shamash stands a little apart and shares its flame. that's a kind of greatness.

2027-12-27.title: going up
2027-12-27.line: in holiness we go up, not down.
2027-12-27.meaning: Hillel's school added a candle each night instead of taking one away. let good things grow.

2027-12-28.title: in the window
2027-12-28.line: place the light where the street can see it.
2027-12-28.meaning: the menorah goes in a window or doorway to share the miracle with passersby.

2027-12-29.title: only to look at
2027-12-29.line: these lights are holy; we may only look at them.
2027-12-29.meaning: from Haneirot Halalu: the candles aren't for reading by. just for seeing and thanking.

2027-12-30.title: rock of ages
2027-12-30.line: Maoz Tzur: rock of my salvation, to praise you is a delight.
2027-12-30.meaning: the song sung after lighting. it tells of rescue after rescue.

2027-12-31.title: enough for eight
2027-12-31.line: one small jar of oil, enough for one day, lasted eight.
2027-12-31.meaning: all eight candles tonight. it's Friday, so light the menorah before the Shabbat candles.
